meta.title: Parallelize Integration Tests
meta.body_summary: Split integration tests into parallel GitHub Actions jobs to reduce execution time under 30 minutes.

perf_labels.notes: Devin split integration tests into parallel jobs and refactored CI; no human review, auto-closed after inactivity.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 2333 changed lines across 10 files, this is a medium-to-large refactor by absolute volume, concentrated in CI workflow YAML and test isolation code; as a CI pipeline optimization PR it was closed without merge due to lack of maintainer engagement.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review or human feedback; Devin bot session died and PR auto-closed after 9 days of inactivity.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce total test execution time by running integration tests in parallel, with a target of under 30 minutes.
review_details.rejection_signals: Devin bot auto-closed; no human interaction.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: CI/CD pipeline changes with complex Docker artifact sharing and test isolation require maintainer review and approval; without human engagement, agent PRs are subject to stale closure.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No runtime metrics or before/after comparison provided; only narrative claim of under 30 min target.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge after agent inactivity.

core_change_summary.description: Split integration tests into parallel GitHub Actions jobs (multi-tenant-tests, standard-tests, connector-tests) with a shared Docker build to reduce overall execution time. Added a composite action for service health checks, refactored test isolation for worker-specific schemas, and included style fixes.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: docker-compose.log was accidentally added with 1626 lines of log output, likely from debugging.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: parallelize integration test jobs in pr-integration-tests.yml.
Added composite action for service health checks.
Updated workflow to use the composite action.
Optimized Docker image compression and artifact sharing.
Refactored test isolation: worker-specific schemas, indexes, and Slack resources.
Multiple style and formatting commits across test files.
Devin session became unreachable, PR closed after inactivity.

review_signals.summary: Devin bot introduction and automatic comment/CI monitoring.
Vercel bot deployment preview for internal-search.
Devin session died, no further updates.
Closing due to inactivity after 7+ days.
